8: 
9:   // Player ship

11:   const shipSpeed = 3;
12: 
13:   // Obstacles and pickups
14:   const asteroids = [];
15:   const fuels = [];

17:     const size = 20+Math.random()*30;
18:     asteroids.push({x:width, y:Math.random()*(height-size), w:size, h:size, speed:2+Math.random()*3});
19:   };
20:   const spawnFuel =()=>{
21:     const size = 15;
22:     fuels.push({x:width, y:Math.random()*(height-size), w:size, h:size, speed:2});
23:   };
24:   let asteroidTimer=0, fuelTimer=0;
25:   let gameOver=false;
26: 
27:   // Input handling
28:   const keys={};
29:   window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{keys[e.key]=true;});
30:   window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{keys[e.key]=false;});
31: 
32:   function update(){
33:     if(gameOver) return;
34:     // player movement
35:     if(keys['ArrowUp']) ship.dy = -shipSpeed;
36:     else if(keys['ArrowDown']) ship.dy = shipSpeed;
37:     else ship.dy = 0;
38:     ship.y += ship.dy;
39:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height-ship.h, ship.y));
40: 
41:     // fuel consumption
42:     ship.fuel -= 0.05;
43:     if(ship.fuel<=0) endGame();
44: 
45:     // spawn obstacles / fuel
46:     asteroidTimer++; fuelTimer++;
47:     if(asteroidTimer>90) {spawnAsteroid(); asteroidTimer=0;}
48:     if(fuelTimer>300) {spawnFuel(); fuelTimer=0;}
49: 
50:     // move asteroids
51:     for(let i=asteroids.length-1;i>=0;i--){
52:       const a=asteroids[i];
53:       a.x -= a.speed;
54:       if(a.x + a.w <0) asteroids.splice(i,1);
55:       else if(collide(ship,a)) endGame();
56:     }
57:     // move fuel cells
58:     for(let i=fuels.length-1;i>=0;i--){
59:       const f=fuels[i];
60:       f.x -= f.speed;
61:       if(f.x + f.w <0) fuels.splice(i,1);
62:       else if(collide(ship,f)) {ship.fuel = Math.min(100, ship.fuel+30); fuels.splice(i,1);}    }
63:   }
64: 
65:   function collide(r1,r2){
66:     return !(r2.x > r1.x + r1.w ||
67:              r2.x + r2.w < r1.x ||
68:              r2.y > r1.y + r1.h ||
69:              r2.y + r2.h < r1.y);
70:   }
71: 
72:   function draw(){
73:     ctx.clearRect(0,0,width,height);
74:     // ship (triangle)
75:     ctx.fillStyle='white';
76:     ctx.beginPath();
77:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h/2);
78:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y);
79:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
80:     ctx.closePath();
81:     ctx.fill();
82:     // asteroids (gray)
83:     ctx.fillStyle='gray';
84:     asteroids.forEach(a=>{ctx.fillRect(a.x,a.y,a.w,a.h);});
85:     // fuel cells (orange)
86:     ctx.fillStyle='orange';
87:     fuels.forEach(f=>{ctx.fillRect(f.x,f.y,f.w,f.h);});
88:     // fuel gauge
89:     ctx.fillStyle='lime';
90:     ctx.fillRect(10,10, ship.fuel*2, 10);
91:     ctx.strokeStyle='black';
92:     ctx.strokeRect(10,10,200,10);
93:     if(gameOver){
94:       ctx.fillStyle='red';
95:       ctx.font='48px sans-serif';
96:       ctx.textAlign='center';
97:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width/2, height/2);
98:     }
99:   }
100: 
101:   function loop(){
102:     if(!gameOver){
103:       update();
104:     }
105:     draw();
106:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
107:   }
108: 
109:   function endGame(){gameOver=true;}
110: 
111:   loop();
112: })();
